title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-018
doc_notes: This document consists of multiple redundant sets of personnel statements from FAA Anchorage Air Route Traffic Control Center employees regarding the Japan Airlines Flight 1628 incident.

incidents.summary: Japan Airlines Flight 1628 reported unidentified traffic with white and yellow strobes paralleling their flight path north of Fairbanks, Alaska.
behavior: stayed with aircraft through turns and descent
incidents.quote: He could not identify but reported white and yellow strobes.
